Management Plan

- Key management actions, treatments, and recommendations:
  - Likely diagnosis: gastroenteritis (viral gastroenteritis prioritized; bacterial causes possible).
  - Antibiotics not recommended at this time.
  - Hydration: encourage persistent fluid intake; consider oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte) to replenish minerals and fluids.
  - Symptom management: paracetamol (two tablets up to four times daily) for fever and weakness during the first few days.
  - Activity: advised to take 2–3 days off work to rest as infection clears.
  - Follow-up: reassess in 3–4 days if symptoms have not improved; potential stool sample if symptoms persist to identify causative agent.
